Add a small matching angular occult rune mark on the TOP/BACK of each paw, integrated into the fur like a dark dried-crimson brand, one clear simple branching geometric sigil per paw; most readable on the near forepaw, no floating runes, no bracelets. 3. One localized DECAYED WOUND on the visible near rear upper thigh, about one quarter of that thigh area: small irregular missing-fur patch, dark desaturated plum-brown recessed center, dry cracked blackened edge with sparse dull gray-olive discoloration. It must read as an old necrotic injury, NOT fresh bleeding, not a decorative patch or stitched fabric. Non-graphic storybook treatment, no exposed bone, muscle, organs, blood drips or gore. REMOVE ALL extra shoulder eyes, fur eye-shaped swirls, double pupils and supernatural extended smile from any previous idea; ordinary mane and original natural wolf grin. On warm parchment, landscape design sheet: main complete full-body creature fills left 75 percent, right column small close-up studies of scarlet-eyed face, marked paw, and damaged thigh, each clearly showing same design as main figure. No text. Consistent restrained cute-creepy game art, not photorealism or 3D. Clearly show exactly four legs, no new appendages.
